main_text.p: חספא Chald. Lutum, proprie figuli, Argilla, Testa argillacea : מנהן די חסף Ex eis, id est, partim ex luto, Dan.2.3. די פרזלא וחספא Ex ferro & ex luto, id est, ferreos & luteos, v.34.
* מחספם m. Rotundum, Exod.16.14. i.e. עגול juxta Ab.Esram.

חסר Defuit, Defecit, Destitutus fuit, Caruit, Eguit, Indiguit: Praeter. לא חסרת דבר Non eguisti ulla re, non defuit tibi quidquam, Deuter.2.v.7. חסרנו כל Eguimus omnibus, Jerem.44.18. Infinit. הלוך וחסור Eundo & deficiendo, Gen.8.5. id est, magis magisq; deficiebant & minuebantur. Pih. חסר Destituit, De-fraudavit, Minuit, Imminuit. Partic. ומחסר את־נפשי מטובה Destituo animam meam bono, Eccles.4.8. Futur, ותחסרהו מעט Et deficere fecisti eum parum ab angelis, Psal.8.6. i.e. minorem pauliper fecisti eum. Hiph.Praeter. המעיט לא החסיר Qui minus colligebat, non eguit, Exod. 16.18. Futur. ומשקה צמא יחסיר Et potum sitientis defi-cere facit, id est, subtrahit, Jesa.32.6.
הסר m. Inopia, Penuria, Defectus: וחסר לחם Et penu-ria panis, Hamos 4.6. ובחסר כל Et in penuria omnium re-rum, Deut.28.48.
חסר Idem: Constr. בחסר־לב ימותו Defectu animi, de-mentia moriantur, Prov.19.21. Et adjective, ut sequitur:
חסר m. Idem, Job.30.3. כי חסר יבאנו Quod inopia ob-veniet ei, Prov.28.22.
חסר m. Deficiens, Destitutus, Carens, Egens, Indi-gens; מה־אתה חסר עמי Cujus tu indigens es apud me? 1.Reg. 11.22. Constr. וחסר לחם At carens vel indigens pane, 2.Sam.3.29.
חסיר Chald. Idem: והשתכחת חסיר Et inventus es deficiens, Dan.5.27.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek vowel points and dagesh are reproduced only as far as legible at this scan resolution; the Hebrew headwords and the citation "1.Reg. 11.22" (printed as II.22 or 11.22) are doubtful. The entry "מחספם" (Exod.16.14) is uncertain. Several Hebrew words in the Deut., Jerem. and Eccles. citations may contain small errors from the scan. The marginal Hebrew in the first entry may be partly misread. No marginal notes, catchword or footnotes are printed.
